# deutschland.de

> > Deutschland.de is Germany's official international portal providing comprehensive information on German politics, economy, culture, society, and global partnerships across multiple languages.

Deutschland.de serves as the primary English-language gateway to understanding contemporary Germany, offering authoritative content on political systems, economic opportunities, cultural heritage, and practical guides for international visitors, students, and workers. The site maintains multilingual versions in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Polish to reach diverse global audiences.

## Key Topics

- German Politics
- International Relations
- Climate Change & Sustainability
- German Culture
- Economy & Business
- Education & Knowledge
- Foreign Policy
- Travel & Tourism
- Working in Germany
- Environmental Protection
- Innovation & Research
- German Language
- News & Current Events

## Core Information

- [deutschland.de - Your link to Germany](https://www.deutschland.de/en): Homepage introducing Germany's politics, business, society, culture and global partnerships
- [Germany at a glance](https://www.deutschland.de/en/germany-at-a-glance): Quick reference facts and figures about Germany's geography and government
- [Germany: Politics](https://www.deutschland.de/en/topic/politics): Overview of Germany's democratic political system and international relations
- [The economy in Germany](https://www.deutschland.de/en/germany-economy): Overview of Germany's economic strength, GDP and business sectors

## Society & Lifestyle

- [Day-to-day life in Germany](https://www.deutschland.de/en/day-to-day-life-in-germany): Guide to German lifestyle, culture, food, housing and celebrations
- [Germany: Culture](https://www.deutschland.de/en/topic/culture): German cinema, art, music, design and cultural events overview
- [Working in Germany](https://www.deutschland.de/en/working-in-germany): Guide for international workers on career opportunities and job market entry
- [Your guide to studying in Germany](https://www.deutschland.de/en/studying-in-germany): Comprehensive guide to universities, programs, visas and scholarships

## Environment & Sustainability

- [Germany: Environment](https://www.deutschland.de/en/topic/environment): Germany's climate protection, renewable energy and environmental initiatives
- [Germany: Knowledge](https://www.deutschland.de/en/topic/knowledge): Germany's research, academic training and innovation leadership

## Practical Guides

- [Travel in Germany](https://www.deutschland.de/en/travel-in-germany): Tourist guide covering entry requirements, destinations and travel planning
- [German language](https://www.deutschland.de/en/learning-german): German language facts, learning resources and course information

## News & Media

- [Germany: Newsroom](https://www.deutschland.de/en/news): Latest political, economic, cultural and social news from Germany
- [Germany: Videos](https://www.deutschland.de/en/videos): Video content on German politics, foreign policy and international relations

## Multilingual Portals

- [deutschland.de - Euer Link zu Deutschland](https://www.deutschland.de/de): German language homepage for Deutschland.de portal
- [deutschland.de - Votre lien avec l'Allemagne](https://www.deutschland.de/fr): French language homepage for Deutschland.de portal
- [deutschland.de - Tu ventana a Alemania](https://www.deutschland.de/es): Spanish language homepage for Deutschland.de portal
- [deutschland.de - Sua ligação com a Alemanha](https://www.deutschland.de/pt-br): Portuguese language homepage for Deutschland.de portal
- [deutschland.de - Wasze łącze z Niemcami](https://www.deutschland.de/pl): Polish language homepage for Deutschland.de portal

## Optional

- [deutschland.de in sign language](https://www.deutschland.de/en/video-site-deutschlandde-in-sign-language): Accessible sign language version of deutschland.de website content
